morning-briefing: At 08:30 the digest job gathers threat intel and sends it to Claude Cowork, which writes a briefing straight back to local files. At 08:45 n8n renders that briefing, runs it through Resend, and delivers it to the work inbox.
discord-task: A Discord message reaches Hermes, which forwards it as an MCP sender into the workspace and on to OpenCode, where four subagents fan out through llama-swap to Ornith-1.5-35B DFlash. Mnemosyne is read and written, the whole run is traced to Langfuse, and the finished result rides back to Discord.
model-swap: When a task needs imagery, llama-swap unloads Ornith-1.5-35B DFlash from the GPU and swaps in ComfyUI so it can generate without contention. As soon as it is done the queue returns to Ornith-1.5-35B DFlash, keeping exactly one member resident at a time.
health-sweep: On schedule cron fires its routine checks and kicks off maintenance across the stack. The metrics those checks produce land in Grafana for a single place to watch health.
off-network-access: A phone joins the tailnet from anywhere and reaches Hermes directly, with no ports or services exposed publicly. It works without opening the homelab up to the rest of the internet.
